title: XS-VLA: Teaching Tiny Vision-Language-Action Models with Spatial Supervision and Demonstration Conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2607.04171v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: How can richer training supervision improve robot control while keeping the deployed policy compact? We present XS-VLA, a staged training framework using teacher-derived spatial labels and demonstration-conditioned action learning. Coarse-Grained Spatial Distillation (CSD) initializes the backbone through an auxiliary region-label task. Latent Flow Matching (LFM) then conditions an action-space velocity field on a demonstration latent, using KL regularization while jointly optimizing the backbone and action modules. The deployed policy contains 243.99M parameters and operates without the teacher or posterior encoder. XS-VLA achieves 90.25% average LIBERO success in each of two training seeds, compared with 86.00% for a SmolVLA-256M base trained under our settings. Ablations examine both training stages through matched image pretraining and Huber/MSE controls. On three Mobile ALOHA tasks, average strict success increases from 21

translated_title: XS-VLA：通过空间监督与示范条件化训练微型视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 如何在保持部署策略紧凑的同时，利用更丰富的训练监督来改进机器人控制？我们提出了XS-VLA，这是一个分阶段的训练框架，采用教师模型生成的空间标签和示范条件化的动作学习。粗粒度空间蒸馏（CSD）通过一个辅助的区域标签任务来初始化骨干网络；随后，潜在流匹配（LFM）将动作空间的速度场条件化于示范的潜在表示，并使用KL正则化，同时联合优化骨干网络与动作模块。最终部署的策略包含243.99M参数，且无需教师模型或后验编码器即可运行。在两个训练随机种子下，XS-VLA在LIBERO上均达到90.25%的平均成功率，而在相同设定下训练的SmolVLA-256M基线仅为86.00%。消融实验通过匹配的图像预训练以及Huber/MSE对照检验了两个训练阶段的有效性。在三个Mobile ALOHA任务上，平均严格成功率从21……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: XS-VLA通过教师空间蒸馏与示范条件化流匹配的两阶段训练，在仅约244M参数的紧凑视觉-语言-动作模型上实现了90.25%的LIBERO平均成功率，超越了更大规模的基线模型。
en_tdlr: XS-VLA uses staged coarse-grained spatial distillation and demonstration-conditioned latent flow matching to train a compact 244M-parameter vision-language-action model that achieves 90.25% average LIBERO success, outperforming larger baselines.
